Engineering High-Performance Bulk Flow Systems

Jayveecons engineers high-performance material handling systems—from screw conveyors to bucket elevators—alongside integrated material processing systems, including crushers, kilns, grinding mills, and air classifiers. Designed for the worl's most demanding bulk processing environments, our solutions deliver maximum throughput, efficiency, and long-term operational reliability across the entire material lifecycle—from raw input to finished product. Introducing VECTOMEC™, our next-generation equipment line.

Who We Are

Built for
Bulk Processing

Jayveecons Consultants and Engineers is the design and engineering arm of the JV Group, working in close integration with our manufacturing partner AkshayVipra El-Mec Pvt. Ltd. to deliver end-to-end solutions for bulk material handling and processing.

From concept to commissioning, we manage the full lifecycle in-house—engineering, fabrication, erection, and support—without outsourcing critical execution.

Every system is refined through three decades of field experience, resulting in equipment engineered for durability, efficiency, and lower lifecycle maintenance.

PHASE 01
Engineering Design
Flow modeling, torque analysis, PSD interpretation, and system configuration. Every system begins as a controlled material flow simulation.
PHASE 02
Fabrication
Precision manufacturing of screw conveyors, classifiers, elevators, and bulk handling systems with controlled tolerances and material-specific optimization.
PHASE 03
Erection & Commissioning
On-site alignment, installation, calibration, and flow validation ensuring real-world performance matches engineered predictions.
PHASE 04
After-Sales Optimization
Continuous system tuning, wear monitoring, and throughput optimization for lifecycle efficiency.

Markets

Industries We Serve

Jayveecons delivers purpose-built, custom-engineered solutions that transform bulk aggregate materials into finished products—efficiently, reliably, and at scale.

Currently serving
Diversifying into
Active
Cement

Integrated equipment solutions for VSK and rotary kiln cement plants, including vertical shaft kilns, grinding systems, material handling and feed systems such as conveyors and elevators alongside clinker coolers, and dust collection units.

Active
Mining & Aggregates

Crushing, screening, and conveying systems for ore, limestone, and aggregate processing, including primary and secondary crushers, vibrating screens, feeders, and bulk material handling solutions designed for efficient, high-throughput operations.

Active
Food & Agriculture

Food-grade material handling and processing systems for dairy, agri-based, and processed food industries, including conveying, dosing, storage, and transfer solutions designed for hygienic operation, product integrity, and consistent performance.

Active
Waste Management

Robust handling and processing for municipal and industrial waste streams.

Diversifying
Oil & Gas

Applying our enclosed conveying, pressure vessel, and abrasion-resistant fabrication experience to upstream and downstream bulk solids handling.

Diversifying
Pharmaceuticals

Our food-grade stainless fabrication capability — hygienic weld geometry, Ra surface finishes, full material certification — translates directly to pharma powder handling.

Diversifying
Agriculture Processing

Large-scale post-harvest handling, drying, and storage — drawing on our food-processing and bulk conveying experience for grain, oilseed, and milling operations.

Active
Steel & Ceramics

High-temperature and abrasion-resistant systems for steel plants and ceramics.

Our Advantage

Why Jayveecons

01
End-to-End Capability

From first engineering sketch to on-site commissioning and long-term parts support — we own every stage. One team, one point of accountability, one standard of quality throughout.

02
Customer-Driven Design

Three decades of customer feedback is baked into every machine we build. Designs that evolve from real operational experience — resulting in equipment with enhanced durability and lower maintenance costs.

03
Built Green from the Start

Lean, energy-efficient equipment design has been our philosophy since before sustainability was an industry buzzword. Our machines do more with less — lower power consumption, longer service life, reduced waste.

04
39 Years. Still Building.

Founded in 1987 by K.R. Subramanian to serve India's small-scale cement sector, Jayveecons has grown into a self-sustained manufacturing company with a 90,000 sq.ft facility. That longevity isn't luck — it's proof.
